verdict.rationale: First-party docs define a skill as a directory containing a `SKILL.md` with name/description frontmatter, plus optional scripts and references. They say skills build on the open agent skills standard, and the plugin manifest has a portable Agent Plugins schema. A hands-on probe installed a catalog skill with third-party `npx skills` tooling and got a plain `SKILL.md` folder with valid frontmatter, and community users confirm skills are Markdown with YAML frontmatter. Missing for 10: hands-on evidence of the same skill folder actually running unchanged in a non-OpenAI harness (the probe installed with `-a codex`)
